Markets.title: ESDS Software surges 235% in 4 sessions as AI infra fever grips markets
Markets.summary: ESDS Software Solutions stock surged 235% over four sessions following its IPO. This rapid growth is driven by high investor demand for Indian cloud technology and artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Markets.title: India’s niche brokers see sharp rise in active trading users
Markets.summary: Smaller, specialized Indian brokerages are experiencing a sharp increase in active trading users and clientele. Meanwhile, large industry giants like Zerodha, Groww, and Angel One are seeing a notable decline in their user growth.

Markets.title: Stocks in news: Reliance Industries, Wipro, ICICI Bank, Coal India and Hindustan Zinc
Markets.summary: Indian equity markets declined on Wednesday, extending a recent corrective phase. Reliance Industries, Wipro, ICICI Bank, Coal India, and Hindustan Zinc are among the companies expected to be in focus following various corporate updates.

Markets.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets faced selling pressure on Wednesday as rising Brent crude oil prices above $100 dampened investor morale and prompted foreign portfolio investors to sell shares. While the rupee declined, domestic institutional investors capitalized on the situation by purchasing stocks.

Markets.title: Sebi proposes easing eligibility norms for MII directors
Markets.summary: Market regulator Sebi has proposed relaxing eligibility rules for directors at Market Infrastructure Institutions. The changes aim to help these institutions more easily find suitable candidates, especially for public interest roles.

Markets.title: Nifty IT index plunges 3.2%, posts biggest single-day fall in 3 months
Markets.summary: The Nifty IT index fell 3.2% on Wednesday, marking its largest single-day drop in three months. The sell-off was driven by renewed risk-off sentiment, US interest rate hike worries, geopolitical tensions, rising oil prices, and visa cost concerns.

Geo-Political.title: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
Geo-Political.summary: Declassified documents reveal that Spanish and Moroccan authorities knew about social media calls for a mass migrant crossing. This warning came just one day before tens of thousands of people entered Ceuta.

Geo-Political.title: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
Geo-Political.summary: Google is investing €13 billion to build a massive data centre in Finland, marking its largest single project in Europe. The tech giant states that this infrastructure development will generate tens of thousands of jobs.

Geo-Political.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
Geo-Political.summary: Global benchmark Brent crude reached $100 a barrel for the first time since July following recent US and Houthi strikes. The price increase came after the United States struck five Iranian tankers on Tuesday.

Geo-Political.title: Iran referred to UN Security Council for nuclear non-compliance
Geo-Political.summary: Iran has been referred to the UN Security Council for non-compliance with its nuclear obligations. Tehran condemned the resolution, blaming recent US and Israeli strikes on its nuclear facilities for disrupting inspections.

Geo-Political.title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win
Geo-Political.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz clashed with AfD leader Alice Weidel during a stormy parliamentary debate following the far-right party's recent election victory. Merz criticized the AfD's migration policy, accusing the party of pursuing "ethnic cleansing" against skilled workers.

Geo-Political.title: US to ban imports of some Canadian alcohol, dairy goods and motorbikes
Geo-Political.summary: The United States is banning imports of specific Canadian alcohol, dairy products, and motorbikes in response to new Canadian counter-tariffs. This action represents the latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the two nations.

Data & Insights.title: Goyal bats for common Brics trade platform, women-focused fund
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal advocated for a common BRICS trade platform at the BRICS Women’s Business Alliance Women-Led Development Conference in New Delhi. He also proposed the creation of a women-focused fund ahead of the group's summit.

Data & Insights.title: India-Thailand trade talks focus on market access, Asean trade agreement review
Data & Insights.summary: India and Thailand have agreed to a time-bound review of their Asean trade agreement to address India's expanding trade deficit, which reached $10.81 billion in 2025. Both countries also pledged to improve market access and strengthen business-to-business connections to achieve more balanced economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: Brent crosses $100 as West Asia war raises pressure on India’s economy
Data & Insights.summary: Brent crude crossed $100 per barrel due to escalating conflict in West Asia. This surge threatens to increase India's oil import bill, raising inflation and fiscal challenges.

Data & Insights.title: Cabinet clears  ₹10,783 crore rail expansion as key corridors near capacity
Data & Insights.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved a ₹10,783 crore rail expansion project covering 655 kilometers to ease congestion on busy corridors. The multi-tracking initiative will add 26.69 million tonnes per annum of freight capacity while creating jobs and reducing carbon emissions.

Data & Insights.title: BJP’s war chest grew  ₹905 crore during 2026 polls, Congress’ shrank  ₹66 crore: What EC data reveals
Data & Insights.summary: Election Commission data shows the BJP's financial war chest grew by ₹905 crore during the 2021 assembly elections in four states and one Union Territory. In contrast, the Congress party's funds shrank by ₹66 crore, reporting net receipts of ₹207.17 crore and an expenditure of ₹248.55 crore during the same period.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | How has LPG supply eased for second-largest global buyer of domestic cooking gas?
Data & Insights.summary: India eased its LPG supply crunch for 340 million consumers by shifting imports to the US and new suppliers while increasing domestic production. Government booking relaxations and diversification efforts also helped stabilize cooking gas availability.

India.title: How Delhi University's Hostel Gap Forces Students Into Private Market
India.summary: Delhi University's severe shortage of hostel accommodations leaves many students with no choice but to rely on private Paying Guests and rented housing. This lack of university housing forces students to navigate the expensive private rental market.

India.title: Guwahati Police Seize Fridge Used To Store Woman's Severed Head
India.summary: Guwahati police seized a refrigerator that was used to store a woman's severed head. Her husband, Ramanuj Goswami, was taken to the house in connection with the crime.

India.title: Assam Official Arrested Over Scam, Used Mimics To Impersonate Chief Minister
India.summary: Assam official Debeswar Sharma was arrested by the Chief Minister's Special Vigilance Cell in a multi-crore corruption case. He allegedly used mimicry to impersonate the Chief Minister during the scams.

India.title: Arvind Kejriwal Unanimously Re-Elected As AAP National Convener
India.summary: Arvind Kejriwal has been unanimously re-elected as the national convener of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP). During the meeting, senior party leaders also discussed the party's future strategy with members.

India.title: 'National Award Not Any State's Property': Gujarat BJP Slams Uddhav Thackeray
India.summary: Gujarat BJP chief spokesperson Dr Anil Patel stated that films from across India compete for National Film Awards. He made this remark in response to criticism from Uddhav Thackeray regarding the awards.

India.title: Apple iPhone Launch Event Live Updates: Apple Launches First Foldable iPhone, Gives Hat-Tip To iPad
India.summary: Apple launched its first foldable iPhone during a major event led by new CEO John Ternus, who succeeded Tim Cook. The presentation also included a nod to the iPad.

General.summary: Police have launched a criminal investigation into donations made to Reform UK. This new inquiry follows a Channel 4 News broadcast and is being combined with an existing investigation into other donations.
